# refl4619 release matrix for issue 4619
#
# Reader held fixed (bin/refl4619.exe, built from refl4619.cpp);
# DXC_REFLECT_DLL varied over each stable release's dxcompiler.dll,
# which is what both compiles the shader and answers the reflection
# calls. Generated by measure-history.py; do not hand-edit.
#
# Prereleases are excluded by policy (SKILL.md). The issue text names
# none, so there is no release-policy.json opt-in.
